period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2013 (Unaudited)", filename '3rd_quearter_2013.pdf' [sic, typo in original filename]), recovered via Wayback Machine capture of the bank's original thecitybank.com/AnnualReport archive (this quarter predates the legacy.citybankplc.com file archive, which has no 2013 entries at all). Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 September 2013' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2013') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 130,794,927,083 + Shareholders' equity 17,789,709,215 = Total assets 148,584,636,298 exactly; Net interest income 3,756,377,374 + Investment income 1,189,447,551 + Commission 809,097,043 + Other operating income 844,606,228 = Total operating income 6,599,528,195 (source document's own subtotal, off by 1 taka from the component sum due to rounding in the original). Note: this quarter's Solo total assets (148,585m) is very slightly higher than the dataset's existing 2013_Q4.json total_assets (147,472m, sourced from a later annual report's summary chart, partial/total-assets-only) -- a small (~0.75%) Q3-to-Q4 dip is plausible from normal balance-sheet fluctuation and is not corrected here, consistent with the project's standing practice of never silently reconciling cross-source differences. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.

source.source_page_lines: Single-page landscape layout (4 panels: Consolidated and Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Cash Flow/Statement of Changes in Equity); scanned/image PDF with no usable text layer, read visually via page render (pdftoppm -r 150)
